description: This file contains functions and classes related to managing DNS zones for a wide area network, including domain normalization, zone file path generation, DNS label sanitization, zone rendering, and file writing with content hashing.

methods.name: normalizeWideAreaDomain
methods.description: Normalizes a domain string by trimming and ensuring it ends with a dot.

methods.name: resolveWideAreaDiscoveryDomain
methods.description: Resolves the wide area discovery domain from environment variables or parameters.

methods.name: getWideAreaZonePath
methods.description: Generates the file path for a DNS zone based on the domain.

methods.name: renderWideAreaGatewayZoneText
methods.description: Renders the DNS zone text for a wide area gateway zone with a given serial number.

methods.name: writeWideAreaGatewayZone
methods.description: Writes the DNS zone file to disk if changes are detected, using content hashing to determine modifications.
